characters.id: dc:Wonder Woman|Golden Eagle Armor Wonder Woman
characters.continuity: DC Comics Post-Crisis / Wonder Woman Vol 2
characters.summary: This specialized variant of Wonder Woman equips the ancient Golden Eagle Armor, granting superior aerial mobility via massive metallic wings and significantly enhanced physical durability against high-tier cosmic and magical threats.

mechanisms: High-density golden armor plating protecting against heavy kinetic and energy attacks
Metallic wings functioning as protective shields

weaknesses: Reduced agility compared to standard unarmored mobility in tight, confined spaces
limitations: Armor weight and wing span can restrict movement in enclosed quarters
characters.formDifferences: Adds massive mechanical-looking golden wings providing powered or natural flight, heavy full-body plate armor, and a specialized helmet, trading off some of her baseline acrobatics for maximum defense and aerial presence.

sources.supports: General character history, publication context, and notable armor iterations.
Documentation of the Golden Eagle Armor's features, wings, and protective durability.

feats.claim: Flew and engaged aerial opponents while donned in the complete Golden Eagle Armor set

notableResults.note: Used the armor's enhanced defense to withstand powerful assaults

conditional.ability: Flight via massive metallic wings and increased damage resistance

campaignTags.claim: Equipped with large metallic wings enabling sustained flight

unknowns: Exact metallurgical composition and limits of the Golden Eagle Armor across different universe reboots

characters.continuity: DC Comics Justice League Dark / The Witching Hour crossover
characters.summary: This mystical incarnation of Wonder Woman harnesses raw, primordial magic tied to Hecate, granting her reality-warping magical capabilities, spellcasting, and mystical weaponry alongside her standard combat prowess.

mechanisms: Divine invulnerability amplified by mystical energy

weaknesses: Vulnerability to corrupting magical influences or counter-magic from higher-tier mystical entities
limitations: Dependence on the magical connection to Hecate for these specific surges of power
characters.formDifferences: Gains direct access to high-tier spellcasting, mystical constructs, and magical energy manipulation at the cost of being tied to dangerous divine covenants.

sources.supports: General overview of Wonder Woman's modern magical storylines and crossovers.
Details on the Witching Hour event, Hecate's Mark, and Wonder Woman's mystical augmentation.

feats.claim: Fought mystical entities using raw magical energy and spells derived from Hecate

notableResults.citation: Justice League Dark and Wonder Woman: The Witching Hour
notableResults.note: Utilized enhanced magical reserves to overcome corrupt entities

conditional.ability: Enhanced reality-warping magic and divine spellcasting
conditional.dependsOn: Carrying the Mark of Hecate during the Witching Hour event

campaignTags.claim: Channels primordial witchcraft and spells granted by the goddess Hecate
Casts complex magical rituals and energy constructs

unknowns: Long-term mental toll of retaining fragments of Hecate's magic after the event

characters.summary: Zatanna Zatara is a powerful stage magician and true Homo Magi who casts potent spells by speaking words backward. She specializes in versatile reality-altering magic, transmutation, elemental control, and protective wards.
weaknesses: Inability to cast spells if rendered mute or unable to speak clearly
Vulnerability to physical surprise attacks before a ward can be erected
limitations: Must be able to speak or vocalize spells backward to achieve complex effects
Extremely draining spells can cause physical exhaustion

sources.supports: Overview of Zatanna's magical abilities, lineage as a Homo Magi, and backward speech.
Detailed breakdown of spellcasting feats, limitations, and notable combat encounters.

feats.claim: Teleported an entire team of heroes across dimensions using backward speech
Transmuted solid objects and erased memories with verbal commands

notableResults.note: Used targeted backward spells to banish entities

campaignTags.claim: Natural Homo Magi capable of manipulating raw magic
Casts diverse spells by speaking incantations backward
Teleports across vast distances via spoken reversal commands

unknowns: Upper limits of her power when drawing directly from extra-dimensional magical planes without exhausting herself

characters.summary: Hunter Zolomon does not tap into the Speed Force like traditional speedsters; instead, he manipulates localized time around himself. By altering his own timestream relative to the universe, he creates the illusion of incomprehensible super-speed, distorts kinetic energy, and inflicts devastating temporal shockwaves.

mechanisms: Passive time dilation making him untouchable to standard linear attacks
Instantaneous recovery from injuries via temporal reversion

weaknesses: Vulnerability to beings capable of operating outside or manipulating standard space-time
Psychological obsession with teaching heroes through brutal trauma
limitations: Powers stem from local time manipulation rather than traditional speed force connectivity, restricting certain inter-dimensional travel without external means

sources.supports: Specific feats regarding time dilation, defeating Flash, and kinetic shockwaves.

feats.claim: Moved so fast by altering personal time that traditional Speed Force users appeared frozen in place
Created massive sonic and kinetic shockwaves simply by snapping his fingers while shifting time

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed Wally West by manipulating time to bypass his reflexes

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how his time manipulation interacts with cosmic entities unbound by conventional chronal flow
